scenarios.title: What is inefficient support costing you in revenue, productivity and trust?
scenarios.description: Customers left waiting, recurring problems and agents stuck on manual tasks: the cost goes beyond support. It shows up in poor experiences, wasted capacity and revenue that never materializes. yapt. connects AI and the platform to organize support. Specialists can help identify bottlenecks and implement the solution.

faq.title: Clarity for those who serve. Visibility for those who decide.

items.question: Can AI work in L1 and L2 support?
items.answer: We can configure agents and procedures for service routines using company knowledge and permitted actions. Scope is defined and tested by scenario, with a handoff to the team when the routine needs human intervention.

items.question: Does AI know who the customer is and which tickets they already have?
items.answer: When the contact is identified and tools are configured, AI can check tickets and use available context. Data, memory and inherited history follow the operation's settings and limits.

items.question: What happens when a person needs to take over?
items.answer: The workflow can check context, generate a summary or note and route service according to configured actions. The handoff preserves available records; generating a summary and transferring are steps that must be part of the workflow.

items.question: How do we track deadlines after AI responds?
items.answer: An automatic response and the first human response are different situations. The team can configure targets and enable time controls according to its process. Assigning a conversation to an agent is not the same as responding to the customer.

items.question: Do we need to replace the systems we already use?
items.answer: The diagnosis defines what to centralize in yapt. and what needs to stay connected. In yaAgents, we can build connections through conversation and make queries, actions and data available within service. Integration depends on the systems, APIs, access and tools available.

items.question: How do we assess whether support has become more efficient?
items.answer: We define the period, cases and criteria before comparing. Waiting, working time, stage progress, reopenings, transfers and answered surveys help investigate bottlenecks. An isolated indicator does not prove quality or savings.

items.question: Does AI learn and change procedures on its own?
items.answer: Knowledge and procedures need organization, review and responsible owners. The implementation can define approval criteria and guide which content AI uses; improvements follow the review process and the company's configuration.

items.question: How do an AI chatbot, tickets and the team work together?
items.answer: An implementation can combine an AI chatbot for WhatsApp customer service, tickets to track each case and copilots to guide the team. The knowledge base provides context; queue rules and SLAs help organize the work. Actions and handoffs depend on the workflow and permissions defined for the operation.
